title: Blue Buggy
summary: A Cross Guild ramp deck. Your Leader can play a Cross Guild Character straight from your hand for 5 rested DON!! and a card, so big Characters arrive early. Many cheap Characters turn into Blockers once you have two big ones out.
gamePlan: Early turns: Mr.3 (OP09-056) and the Cross Guild Event dig for Cross Guild cards. Alvida (ST25-001) draws 3.
Use the Leader: rest 5 DON!! and trash 1 card to play any Cross Guild Character from your hand, even a 9 or 10 cost one.
Once you have 2 Characters with a base cost of 5 or more, Cabaji and Mohji become Blockers.
Crocodile & Mihawk and the 9-cost Alvida (EB05-021) draw cards and play more Cross Guild Characters for free.
The 10-cost Buggy puts an opposing Character on the bottom of their deck. It also goes to the bottom itself unless you have 5 Characters that cost 5 or more.

keyCards.why: Leader. Plays a Cross Guild Character from hand for 5 rested DON!! and a card.
Mr.3. 1-cost searcher for Cross Guild and Baroque Works cards.
Crocodile & Mihawk. Draws 2, then plays another Cross Guild Character.
Alvida. Draws 2 and plays a Cross Guild Character costing up to 8.
Buggy. Removes a Character by putting it on the bottom of the deck.

howItWins: Big bodies early. Your Leader cheats out Characters a few turns ahead of schedule, and the Blockers keep you safe while they attack.
weakTo: Decks that bounce or shrink your big Characters right after you play them.
Hands with no Cross Guild Characters: then the Leader does nothing.
mulliganTips: Keep a searcher and at least one Cross Guild Character costing 6 or more for the Leader to play.
